confidence_notes: Low confidence: holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live prices or listings. Argentina's peso prices and exchange rate are highly volatile, so July 2026 USD levels could differ materially. Restaurant anchors are the most grounded; accommodation and drinks are the least certain. Cocktail is set at about twice the beer anchor and the wine glass near the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weak. Mid-to-late July winter school holidays may firm accommodation demand. The inexpensive meal assumes one main course with a soft drink. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to RBA exchange-rate pages; those pages were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Other large South American tourist capitals (Santiago, Montevideo) were used as a rough cross-check; Buenos Aires is placed below them for most restaurant and hotel categories, consistent with its generally lower visitor price levels in USD in recent years. No web search was used for prices.
